title: obey-voice.scene.v1
description: A scripted spoken conversation between personas: who is in the cast, and either the lines they speak (verbatim) or the beats they improvise from (generate). A scene carries no STT, VAD, tools, skills, or meeting settings; the mouth of each speaker comes from their persona profile. Generated from internal/scene.Document and kept in step by TestSceneSchemaMatchesDocument.

title.description: Optional display title, recorded in the run manifest.

mode.description: Where the spoken lines come from. Empty means verbatim. The CLI --mode flag overrides this only when it is passed.

pause.description: Go duration of silence between turns, e.g. 400ms. Empty inherits the 400ms default. The CLI --pause flag overrides this only when it is passed.

cast.description: The speakers. v1 records exactly two; the schema allows more so an N-cast script keeps validating once the renderer grows into it.

id.description: Scene-local speaker id, unique within the cast. Turns name this, not the persona id, so a recast does not rewrite every line. It is also the turn WAV filename component.

persona.description: Id of a festival-voice.persona.v1 profile under the install's personas directory.

display_name.description: Output-only. The persona's display name at the time of the run.

tts_provider.description: Output-only. The effective TTS provider after the persona was applied.

tts_voice.description: Output-only. The effective voice id after the persona was applied.

tts_tier.description: Output-only. The effective Qwen model tier, empty for other providers.

brain_provider.description: Output-only. The brain provider that wrote, or would have written, this speaker's lines.

brain_model.description: Output-only. The model behind brain_provider, when the provider names one.

turns.description: The spoken lines. Required and non-empty in verbatim mode; in generate mode these are written by the renderer.

text.description: The line to speak. Spoken-text cleaning happens inside the TTS provider.

scene.description: The improvisation brief. Required for generate mode; preserved but unused in verbatim mode.

setting.description: One line of situation, given to both brains in the shared briefing.

beats.description: What has to happen, in order. Generate mode needs beats or an opener.

opener.description: A written first line, so the opening speaker does not have to invent one.

speaker.description: A cast id. Empty opens with the first cast member.

text.description: The opening line, spoken verbatim as turn 0.

max_turns.description: Cap on generated turns. Empty inherits the default of 24. The CLI --max-turns flag overrides this only when it is passed.

stop_phrases.description: Case-sensitive substrings that end the conversation. The matching line is kept and then spoken.

generate_fingerprint.description: Output-only. A generated run's resolved script records a SHA-256 of the brief its lines came from (renderer version, persona ids, setting, beats, opener, authored turns), so --resume keeps a prefix only when it was written for this same brief. Leave it out of authored documents; the loader ignores it.
